meta.promptText: India mein shaadi ke liye budget mein online konsi sarees kharidun?

response.text:
Shaadi ke liye budget mein **Banarasi jacquard, silk-blend, georgette-sequin, Chanderi aur Kanjivaram-look sarees** achhi rahengi. Online options roughly **₹300–₹1,500** mein mil jaate hain; Meesho par kai wedding sarees ₹250–₹650 ke aas-paas listed hain, jabki Libas par silk-blend options ₹759–₹1,259 se shuru hote hain.[1][4][6]

### Budget ke hisaab se best choices

- **₹300–₹600: Banarasi jacquard ya art-silk saree** — shaadi guest, reception aur family functions ke liye; Flipkart par examples ₹420–₹540 ke aas-paas mil rahe hain.[2]
- **₹400–₹800: Kanjivaram-look silk saree** — traditional aur rich appearance; Meesho par Kanjivaram-style options lagbhag ₹290 se listed hain.[1]
- **₹500–₹1,000: Georgette/net saree with sequin work** — sangeet ya reception ke liye lightweight aur glamorous.
- **₹750–₹1,300: Silk-blend embroidered saree** — better finishing aur blouse-piece quality ke liye Libas jaise platforms par options milte hain.[6]
- **₹1,000–₹1,500: Chanderi, organza ya heavy embroidery saree** — elegant look, especially pastel shades mein.

### Colour suggestions

- **Bride/family member:** wine, maroon, rani pink, bottle green, purple ya traditional red  
- **Guest:** peach, lavender, teal, mustard, powder blue ya emerald green  
- **Day wedding:** pastel Chanderi, organza ya printed silk  
- **Night function:** black, navy, wine ya magenta with sequin border  

### Online kharidte waqt

- Product reviews mein **customer photos** zaroor dekhein.
- “Silk” ke bajay material description check karein—kai budget sarees **art silk ya silk blend** hoti hain.
- Blouse piece, saree length, return policy aur delivery date verify karein.
- ₹300–₹500 ke options mein finishing variable ho sakti hai; safer choice ke liye **₹700–₹1,200** ka budget rakhein.
- Search terms use karein: **“Banarasi jacquard saree,” “Kanjivaram silk blend saree,” “sequin georgette saree,” “Chanderi festive saree.”**

**Sabse safe budget pick:** ₹500–₹800 ki **wine, bottle-green ya magenta Banarasi/silk-blend saree**, zari border aur matching unstitched blouse ke saath.
